categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: public engineering, private construction, real estate development, and overseas business. It undertakes large-scale infrastructure projects, urban renewal, industrial park development, and integrated construction services including civil, architectural, and electromechanical engineering.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction technologies such as Building Information Modeling (BIM), smart construction management systems, AIoT for site monitoring, and digital decision platforms. It focuses on innovative construction methods including prefabrication, aluminum formwork, and green building materials to enhance efficiency, quality, and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies commissioning public infrastructure projects, private developers for residential and commercial buildings, industrial clients for factory and industrial park development, and overseas partners in Vietnam and Myanmar. Major markets are Taiwan’s northern, central, and southern regions, with expanding presence in Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, especially northern Taiwan, with significant projects also in central and southern Taiwan. The company is expanding its overseas footprint in Vietnam and Myanmar through subsidiaries and joint ventures, focusing on construction and real estate development in these emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream construction contractor and developer, managing project design, procurement, construction, and development. It integrates upstream supply of construction materials through long-term supplier relationships and downstream delivery of completed infrastructure and real estate projects to clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding project scale, enhancing technical competitiveness, driving digital transformation, and deepening sustainability initiatives. R&D focuses on optimizing construction management systems, smart site monitoring, AI integration, green building technologies, and customer relationship management systems to improve operational efficiency and project quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through contract-based project construction services, including lump-sum turnkey contracts and cost-plus contracts. Additional income derives from real estate sales and leasing, industrial park land development, and overseas project execution. The company also earns from equipment rental and consulting services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan’s construction industry, competing with major firms such as Continental Engineering Corporation, CTCI Corporation, and Tachin Construction. It holds a strong market position in large public infrastructure projects and urban renewal, leveraging its technical expertise and integrated service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$23.85 billion in 2024, showing a 25.78% increase from the previous year, with net profit after tax of NT$724 million. Total assets grew by 16.03% to NT$65 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial stability. The company maintains a robust order backlog with multi-year large-scale projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable operation, innovation, digital transformation, and sustainable development to deliver high-quality, cost-effective construction solutions. Its unique value lies in integrating vertical supply chains, applying smart construction technologies, and offering comprehensive urban renewal and industrial park development services tailored to client needs.
